title: Your parking

noVisit.title: No parking found
noVisit.body: Ask a volunteer at the gate if you were checked in.

login.title: Get your parking link
login.body: Enter the mobile number you gave at the gate. We'll send the link on WhatsApp.
login.expired: That link has expired. Get a new one below.
login.sent: If this number has parking today, a link is on its way on WhatsApp.

consent.title: Allow location to get directions to your slot
consent.body: Your location is shared with the event team only while you drive to your slot. It stops once your parking is confirmed.

locationOff.body: Location is off. You can still see your slot on the map.

locationHelp.title: Turn on location
locationHelp.chrome1: Tap the lock icon next to the address bar.
locationHelp.chrome3: Choose Allow, then reload this page.
locationHelp.safari1: Open Settings, then Privacy and Security, then Location Services.
locationHelp.safari2: Turn on Location Services and set Safari Websites to While Using.
locationHelp.safari3: Come back to this page and reload it.

markParkedConfirm: Only tap this after your vehicle is in slot {{slot}}.
waitingCheck: Waiting for the volunteer to check your parking
farFromSlot: You seem to be away from slot {{slot}}. A volunteer will check.
visitEnded: Thanks for visiting. Your visit has ended.
visitCancelled: This parking was cancelled. Ask a volunteer at the gate.

menu.title: Menu
menu.sharingOn: The event team can see where you are

find.followMap: Walk to slot {{slot}} on the map
find.noLocation: Turn on location to get walking directions.

nav.slotOnLeft: Your slot is on the left
nav.slotOnRight: Your slot is on the right

sos.label: SOS
sos.title: Need help?
sos.body: The event team will see your location and vehicle.
sos.sent: Help request sent. Keep your phone with you.
